card.label: S. 93
card.summary: The Harmful Algal Bloom and Hypoxia Research and Control Amendments Act of 2025 extends and modifies federal programs through fiscal year 2030 to research, monitor, forecast, and mitigate harmful algal blooms and hypoxia across marine, estuarine, and freshwater systems in the United States. It updates the duties of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration and the Environmental Protection Agency, expands the Inter-Agency Task Force on Harmful Algal Blooms to include the Department of Energy, and establishes a national observation network and incubator program.
